data.name: Zaynabina
data.short_meaning: Giver of Glad Tidings, Fragrant Flower
data.long_meaning: She who is a giver of glad tidings, a sign of God's mercy and blessings, and a fragrant flower in gardens of Paradise
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of God's blessings, love, and joy, and a reminder of the beauty and peace found in gardens of Paradise

in_arabic.name: زينبينة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني زينب بنت النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مؤنث مشتق من اسم زينب بنت جحش زوجة النبي محمد صلى الله عليه وسلم، وهي ابنة عمته السيدة زينب بنت خزيمة. يعني الاسم بالجمال والزينة، ويرتبط بالسيدة زينب بنت النبي التي كانت معروفة بكرمها وإنصافها.

in_urdu.name: زینبینه
in_urdu.meaning: زینب نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کی بیٹی کا نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ نام نبی کریم صلی اللہ علیہ وسلم کی بیٹی زینب بنت جحش سے ماخوذ ہے، جو ان کی زوجہ اور ابناء عمت تھیں۔ اس نام کا مطلب ہے خوبصورتی اور زینت، اور یہ سيدة زینب کی شہرت کرم و انصاف کے ساتھ منسلک ہے۔

in_hindi.name: ज़ैनबिना
in_hindi.meaning: नबी की बेटी का नाम, जीनत और सजावट
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम नबी मुहम्मद की बेटी ज़ैनब बिन्त जिहाश से लिया गया है, जो उनकी पत्नी और चचेरी बहन थीं। इसका अर्थ है सुंदरता और आभूषण, और यह सिदीहा ज़ैनब की उदारता और न्याय के साथ जुड़ा हुआ है।

in_pashto.name: زینبینه
in_pashto.meaning: د نبي د لور نوم، ښکلا او زيورات
in_pashto.long_meaning: دا نوم د نبي محمد د لور زينب بنت جحش څخه اخستل شوی دی، چې د هغه ښځه او د عمت لور وه. دا نوم ښکلا او زيورات معنی لري، او د سيدې زينب د کرم او انصاف سره تړلی دی.

in_english.name: Zaynabina
in_english.meaning: Derived from Zaynab, meaning beauty and adornment
in_english.long_meaning: The name Zaynabina is derived from the Arabic root 'z-y-n-b', which means 'beauty' or 'adornment'. It is associated with Zaynab bint Jahsh, a wife of the Prophet Muhammad and a cousin. The name holds significance in Islamic tradition for its connection to a revered figure known for her generosity and justice.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Zaynabina" holds immense cultural significance in the Islamic world, as it is the name of prominent figures in Islamic history, most notably the granddaughter of Prophet Mohammad (PBUH). Zaynab bint Ali (RA), who was known for her exceptional beauty, wisdom, and piety, is a beloved figure in the Islamic tradition. Her name has been passed down through generations and is still popular among Muslims worldwide.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name "Zaynabina" is deeply rooted in Islamic beliefs. The name suggests one who is a giver of glad tidings, signifying hope and optimism, which is an essential aspect of faith in God. It also symbolizes God's mercy and blessings, reminding us of His infinite kindness towards His creation. Additionally, the name suggests fragrance, which is a metaphor for the spiritual pureness and closeness to God that one can achieve through piety and devotion. Overall, the name "Zaynabina" represents the eternal beauty, wisdom, and spiritual teachings of one of the most revered figures in Islamic history, and serves as a constant reminder of the promises of paradise and God's mercy for the faithful.
